title: Lekalo MCP tool output: context
description: Issue #33 closed result envelope of the context tool. status "valid" carries the preserved core receipt in "result"; every other status carries the typed "failure" branch and never a fabricated payload. The status/result|failure coherence is the published conditional; embedded core payloads are the exact bundled upstream definitions.

diagnostics.description: Wire diagnostic items (lekalo/diagnostic/v0.2.16) resolved against dev.lekalo.diagnostic-registry@0.8.0; every item is the closed published projection bundled under $defs.diagnosticItem.

profile.description: The closed built-in profile id that ran (`default` or `strict`).

profileVersion.description: The exact profile document version that ran.

registryVersion.description: The exact diagnostic registry version the findings resolve against.

moduleScope.description: Present only for a `--module`-scoped run; the module semantic id scope.

rulesEnabled.description: The number of rules the profile enabled.

diagnosticItem.description: One closed `lekalo/diagnostic/v0.2.16` item: a faithful projection of the governing `contracts/diagnostic.schema.v0.2.16.json` (same grammars, bounds, and closed object shapes) with the receipt-level constants pinned.

registry_version.description: The exact registry version the item resolves against: the MCP union successor (0.8.0) for transport diagnostics, or the accepted predecessor pin of a preserved domain diagnostic.

max.description: The member is required in the source document and carried in the IR; null is the explicit unbounded spelling.
